name: serverUrl
label: Server URL
help: The address used to open Octopus Deploy in a browser, for Octopus Cloud or a self-hosted Octopus Server

pattern.message: Enter the full address of the Octopus server, e.g. https://example.octopus.app

name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Create an API key in Octopus under **Profile > My API Keys**. See [How to create an API key](https://octopus.com/docs/api/authentication/create-an-api-key)
